task: When should we schedule maintenance on the charging stations in the Bolzano area to minimise impact on users? Propose concrete weekday/time windows backed by observed usage.
markdown:
## Answer
The best-supported maintenance slot in the Bolzano area is early weekday morning, 05:00-07:00 on Thursday, Tuesday or Friday, when pooled occupancy was lowest. These windows rest on only 4-5 comparable dates each, so treat them as a provisional starting point rather than a firm conclusion. [E2]

## Key findings
- Overall Bolzano occupancy was 0.435 across the 56-day window (2026-09-19 to 2026-11-14). [E2]
- The three lowest-usage 2-hour windows are Thu 05:00-07:00 (0.066, 5 comparable dates), Tue 05:00-07:00 (0.124, 4 dates) and Fri 05:00-07:00 (0.146, 4 dates). [E2]
- Occupancy climbs sharply after 06:00: Thu is 0.08 at 06:00 and 0.26 at 07:00, so work should finish by 07:00. [E2]
- The busiest windows to avoid are Wed 20:00-22:00 (0.72), Sat 21:00-23:00 (0.654) and Mon 20:00-22:00 (0.651). [E2]
- Weekday daytime hours run at roughly 0.4-0.66, for example Thu 08:00 at 0.661, so they are poor slots. [E2]
- Overnight hours 00:00-04:00 are often 0.0 or null (no observable data), so they cannot be confirmed as quiet. Saturday nights are high (Sat 02:00 is 0.821). [E2]
- BZ_BOEHLER_01 (one point) has a peak local hour of 5 and full_time 0.57, so a 05:00-07:00 slot there needs a site-specific check. [E3]

## Recommendation
1. Schedule routine, area-wide maintenance on Thu 05:00-07:00 first, with Tue and Fri 05:00-07:00 as alternatives. [E2]
2. Avoid weekday evenings (Mon and Wed 20:00-22:00), Saturday late evening and all weekend nights. [E2]
3. For BZ_BOEHLER_01, choose a different slot or confirm local use before working at 05:00-07:00. [E3]
4. For the other high-occupancy sites (BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 at 0.669, BZ_P_VITTORIA at 0.635), run per-site hourly profiles before fixing a time, since the pooled profile may not match them. [E3]
5. Pilot the Thursday slot and re-check with more weeks of data before making it a standing schedule.

## Limitations & unknowns
- The three low-usage windows rest on 4-5 comparable dates, the minimum threshold; 44 grid cells fell below it and were excluded. [E2]
- The profile pools all sites. No per-site hourly profiles were run, so the windows are not confirmed for individual sites. [E2, E3]
- Top-site coverage is low (BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 0.147, BZ_P_VITTORIA 0.082, BZ_C_AUGUSTA_01 0.044, BZ_RESSEL_01 0.033), and 22 sites were excluded for under 24 h of exposure, so site-level conclusions are weak. [E3]
- Only 43 of 51 sites had data in the window. [E1]
- The data show occupancy status only, not energy, sessions, demand or faults. Null means unknown, not zero. [E1]

## Sources
- [E1] dataset_overview — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E2] hourly_profile(scope=bolzano) — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E3] rank_sites(metric=occupancy) — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14

- **Key caveat:** The 05:00-07:00 slot rests on only 4-5 comparable dates per window (Thu 0.066), pooled across all sites with no per-site profiles. Treat it as a pilot, not a standing schedule.
- **Overnight blind spot:** 00:00-04:00 is often 0.0 or null (unknown), so quiet is unconfirmed. Coverage is weak (e.g., 0.033-0.147 at top sites).
- **Untraced values:** The 05:00, 07:00 and 08:00 time labels and the "4" in "4-5 dates" didn't trace. 61 of 67 numbers traced, and all 21 citations are valid. The untraced items look like formatting, but verify the "4" against E2.
